visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable/source-terrain frames, including the 1024x640 summary. The individual rough-stone church has west and south rose gables, steep intersecting red tiled roofs, three unequal tapering spires with green tips, triple tall-tower louver panels, smaller pointed louvers, gabled west portal, round stair turret, southeast sacristy and two mapped open pedestrian gatehouses with short red-capped wall wings. Corrected portal depth, unsupported lower-canopy lights, a north light outside its wall, sacristy-window occlusion, hidden short-tower panels and buried tower corner roofs. Hidden roof joins and fine stone/glass details remain approximate.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final shared/geographic frames. Five existing cached 256-square dry-stone, granite, ceramic tile, copper and plain wood graphs serve seven merged groups. The dry-stone pattern approximates the varied granite masonry; exact dressed-block courses are not reproduced. Opaque louver panels use the trim slot to retain their timber tint. Metric UVs, linear colors, flat architectural normals and local blue-gray PBR glazing; no embedded images, private facade maps, photo textures or baked lighting. Every shared graph loads once, unload leaves zero live model geometries and restores the terrain opening. Flat-fixture edge slivers reflect the DEM-fitted apron meeting unmatched flat ground; this is not terrain accuracy approval.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 final medium-fi frames: Economy/High, noon/late, three distances, texture-free silhouette, six details, four matched whole LODs and four transitions. Skyline 791 triangles retains all three unequal spires, both rose gables, irregular roof, portal/round turret, two gate passages and low wall wings. District 2403 adds shared surfaces, front/side light rhythm and grouped louver/roof bands. Street 5433 adds actual recessed openings, lead-grid abstraction, cornices and buttress caps. Close-up/master 7269 refine lead/louver spacing and sparse roof ribs. Distant grouped panels and omitted small lights are intentional. Regional Finnish log cabins are fixtures. Physical laptop/phone timing remains pending.
